reply_text:
Found **one merge-blocking issue** in `main...dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`):

**[P1] Dedupe uses object identity instead of contact ID — `src/dedupe.js:2`**
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Separate imports produce different objects with equal IDs, so `mergeImports` retains duplicates—the main case this branch is meant to handle.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
Both contacts are returned. Per the README, only the first should remain.

**Suggested fix:** Track seen IDs and retain the first contact for each. Add regression tests for equal IDs on different objects, both directly in `dedupe` and across lists in `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss that case. No other findings; no files changed.
